text: 🇲🇽✊ Mexico is launching a Universal Health Credential — 2,136 enrollment modules nationwide, starting January 2027. — Secretaría de Salud, mañanera May 26 Registration by last-name letter, Mon-Sat schedule, deadline Nov 14. Benefits: emergency care, Código Infarto, Código Cerebro. Plus: 177M pesos for ISSSTE therapy rooms, new linear accelerator in Tabasco (80 patients/day).

🇲🇽✊ "We have to be close, active, informing about this offensive against us." — Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera May 26 Sheinbaum called on supporters to mobilize for May 31. The movement responds to a sustained media and political offensive against the Fourth Transformation government.

🇲🇽🎨 "It's called 'Grandiose Humanity' — for us as humanists, it's an exceptional title." — Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera May 26 Sheinbaum highlighted Pope Francis' new encyclical on AI regulation. "It doesn't just talk about the importance of regulating artificial intelligence — it asks who controls it."

🇲🇽✊ Mexico's door-to-door health program has completed over 18 million home visits to elderly and disabled citizens in under a year. "Salud Casa por Casa guarantees the right to health for elderly adults and people with disabilities" — Salud Casa por Casa, mañanera May 26 Started June 2025. Three rounds: clinical records, lab screenings, preventive care. On track for 20M+ visits by year-end.

🇲🇽🔍 "There is a 44% reduction in homicides." — Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera May 26 The number rarely makes international headlines. Mexico's security strategy — addressing root causes combined with intelligence-led coordination — has cut homicides by nearly half.

🔥🇲🇽 "There is so much freedom of expression that from a TV network the government is permanently attacked, even with lies." — Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera May 26 Sheinbaum responded to censorship accusations after calling on viewers not to watch TV Azteca. "It's not censorship, it's an opinion. I'm not exercising state power to censor a network."

🇲🇽🌎 Mexico just posted a record $23.6 billion in foreign direct investment in Q1 2026 — up 10.4% year-over-year. "Very good news on economic results: record foreign direct investment of $23.591 billion in the first quarter" — Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera May 26 Exports grew 21.8% Jan-Apr. Trade surplus hit $3.5B. Top investors: US, Spain, Australia, Japan, Canada (73.5% of total FDI).
